user.title: Add a Things node manually
user.description: Only needed if discovery didn't find it automatically - the node has to be attached to Thread and SRP-registered first. Capabilities are chosen on the next page.

data.name: Node name (must match its SRP hostname, e.g. "chiggy-room-climate")

swing_axis.title: Swing axis
swing_axis.description: This node has AC/climate control - which physical swing axis does the unit actually have a motor for? A unit only ever has one working axis, even if its IR protocol technically supports both.
